viewpoints.name: Point Reyes Lighthouse Observation Deck
viewpoints.description: An observation deck high above the Pacific near the Point Reyes Lighthouse. Conditions can be very windy.

photos.author: MARELBU
photos.caption: Point Reyes Lighthouse, CA USA - panoramio (1).jpg

verification.subjectNote: Photo subject and source description reviewed against the named viewpoint.

hours.value: Observation deck open until about 11:45 pm daily. The area west of the parking-roundabout gate closes midnight–6 am. Lighthouse stairs and visitor-center hours are separate and subject to staffing/weather.

fees.note: Not established from the reviewed sources. Check with the land manager before visiting.

parking.value: 38-space main lot; parking fills, especially afternoons.

elevationFeet.note: Not established from the reviewed sources. Check with the land manager before visiting.

terrain.value: Paved uphill approach; observation deck above a long staircase.

accessibility.value: From the designated accessible parking area, an approximately 400-foot accessible path reaches the visitor center and upper observation deck. The lighthouse below requires 313 steps.

facilities.value: Restrooms at the visitor parking lot and near the green garages are listed as open 6 am–midnight. A drinking-water filling station is near the garages.

seasonalAccess.value: Check lighthouse stairway and visitor-center hours separately from upper-deck access.

cautions.value: Stairs close when winds exceed 40 mph; the upper observation deck can remain available when stairs are closed. Cell service is minimal. Stay behind railings and off unstable bluffs.

dogs.value: Pets may use the parking lot and Sir Francis Drake Boulevard east of it; otherwise they are prohibited in the lighthouse area. Working service dogs are excepted.
